benchmark: data/benchmark/retrieval/queries.json (15 hand-authored queries against the 15-passage legal corpus)
limitations: Corpus has only 15 passages - this benchmark demonstrates the retrieval pipeline (dense/BM25/RRF) works correctly end-to-end, not that it generalizes to a large real-world legal corpus. Near-perfect recall at this corpus size is expected and not evidence of strong ranking quality at scale.
Queries were authored knowing which passage they target - not collected from real user behavior.
